name: Hybrid Physics-Driven Procedural Model
aliases: Hybrid Physics-Driven Procedural Model (Goswami/Neyret), Macro-Physics Micro-Rendering
definition: A hybrid, physics-driven procedural model for real-time cumulus cloud animation and rendering on the landscape scale.
summary: The Hybrid Physics-Driven Procedural Model simulates cumulus clouds in real-time by combining macro-level Lagrangian physics with micro-level procedural rendering, offering physical plausibility at low computational cost.
